reason: A realtime agent collaboration mesh providing project presence, peer messaging, message history, commands, and optional WebSocket hub connectivity; human review is warranted because the README documents unauthenticated endpoints and inbound session injection.

summaries.zh: 为多个智能体提供基于项目的实时在线状态、点对点或广播消息、消息历史以及可选的 WebSocket 集线器连接。
summaries.en: Provides project-scoped realtime agent presence, direct or broadcast messaging, message history, and optional WebSocket hub connectivity.

capabilities: Runs an optional local hub server with HTTP and WebSocket endpoints
Maintains project-scoped agent presence and append-only message history
Sends direct or broadcast messages with optional file attachments
Injects inbound messages into agent sessions
Can persist connection settings and automatically reconnect
